$comment: Files the project needs but keeps out of git (no open license, or too large). They live in the owner's iCloud Drive under `folder`; `pnpm private:sync` copies them to `to` and checks the hash. Names and hashes only: nothing here is secret.

files.why: The owner's class timetable and uniform rules, the default every child starts from (TIMETABLE_DEFAULT_FILE); names a school and a teacher, so it stays out of the public repo.
